services.desc: is a traditional Korean martial art that emphasizes fast and powerful striking with the hands and feet. The practice of Tae Kwon Do develops strength through a wide range of motion, and also enhances balance, flexibility, cardio-respiratory fitness, agility, timing and coordination. The practice of traditional martial arts develops mental and physical resilience, and has been demonstrated to positively affect students' behavior in other areas of their lives.
